method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; creative edits performed with the same tool.

references.role: Orya, the cosmic woman inside the sphere; identity, mantle, cosmic body and ring setting.
The distinct cyan-hooded external keeper and handheld glass enclosure.
Collection oil-painting brushwork only; no orchard subject imported.

cover.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: novel cover, 9:16 portrait, to be saved at 864 x 1536.
Text (verbatim), render EXACTLY ONCE: "The Unspent Star". Elegant readable ivory serif lettering in quiet upper space, integrated into the painting. No author name, no other text.
Input images: image 1 is the authoritative identity of ORYA, the cosmic WOMAN INSIDE the sphere; image 2 is the distinct OUTSIDE KEEPER and two-hand enclosure; image 3 is brushwork/style only (do not import its orchard, palette, or subject).
Primary request: A beautiful unsettling oil-painted cover for a universe-in-a-bottle story. Give the woman INSIDE the sphere the prominent, clearly recognizable silhouette. She is an adult feminine living cosmic figure, wholly opaque dark star-filled body, a face of darkness without visible features, rose-pink hood and long flowing rose mantle with cyan lining, perforations and loose streamers; her bare feet hover above pink planetary rings around a dark world. A little rose star with a pale trailing edge floats beside her shoulder. Her identity MUST match image 1; she is not an ordinary human in a coat.
Composition: a very large CLEAR glass sphere occupies the central and lower picture, complete circumference visible; her entire body, mantle, star and world are visibly enclosed within it. Her own sky feels immense within the globe. The cyan-hooded keeper of image 2 stands behind and above, faceless dark hood, cyan outer robe with rose/nebula lining, just two coherent cupped hands holding the sphere. Distinguish pink interior woman's hood from blue outside keeper. Keep both hands anatomically coherent. The prominent woman and rings are surrounded by dark quiet star fields; a restrained curved glass edge reveals custody. Depict the earlier transparent-globe moment, not the final opaque shell. Her pose expresses guarded curiosity, not a pinup.
Style/medium: Canadian Group of Seven inspired oil painting. Match reference 3's broad rhythmic color/value shapes, varied directional opaque strokes, quieter connecting passages, selective impasto, connected shadows and lost edges. Motivate rose and cyan light from the inner stars/robe, retain substantial near-black passages. Painterly stars and glass, no glossy CGI, no photograph, no bevelled uniform strokes, no huge lens flare, no automatic orange-blue scheme. No extra figures, no boots, no ordinary human face, no nudity or sexual emphasis, no story synopsis on cover.
cover.selection: Earlier transparent-globe moment; prominent original cosmic woman wholly inside glass, distinct cyan keeper and two cupped hands; exact title rendered once.
cover.normalization: Resampled generated portrait to required dimensions and encoded JPEG; no creative editing with Python.

character_sheet.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: modest character reference sheet, landscape 1536 x 1024.
Text (verbatim): "Orya" and "The Unspent Star", both clearly legible at top, each once. Labels: "Front", "Side", "Back", "Guarding", "Wonder", "Making".
Input images: image 1 is Orya's cosmic identity and rose/cyan mantle; image 2 is collection brushwork only. Preserve her cosmic personhood, empty hood and star-filled extremities.
Primary request: useful multiview sheet of a FULLY DRAPED cosmic character, Orya. Three full-body views Front, Side, Back; two hood-and-hand gesture studies Guarding and Wonder; small Making study of her cosmic hands looping a mantle thread around a dream-star to condense a tiny world.
In ALL views the rose-pink mantle hangs loosely and CLOSED around her torso and hips, down nearly to her feet; layered opaque rose and cyan cloth completely covers chest, abdomen, pelvis and backside. Loose flowing fabric, not fitted to anatomy. The same perforations and loose streamers belong to the outer mantle, with solid cyan inner folds keeping the figure fully draped. Show dark living cosmic material only at the featureless hood interior, hands, wrists and bare feet, with tiny lights within it. Her stance and hands can imply the star-filled living body without anatomical contours. No human face, visible eyes or mouth; no hair. Quiet neutral front/side/back postures, coherent hands and feet, same hood/clasp/mantle across views. Guarding wraps a small rose star in intact cyan lining; Wonder tilts the dark empty hood toward that light; Making shows hands and a thread loop only. A rose light has a pale trailing edge, not a creature. This is clothing/identity continuity art, NOT anatomical study.
Style: Group of Seven inspired oil painting, broad varied opaque directional strokes, quiet gray parchmentlike background with enough contrast for the dark hands, clean panel separation, readable cream/black simple serif labels. Do not include the outside keeper, a full scene instead of sheet, or a glass bubble in each panel.
character_sheet.correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: final correction of Orya character reference sheet, landscape 1536 x 1024.
Input image is the edit target, already approved fully draped reference sheet. Change ONLY the world in the lower-right panel labelled "Making".
Replace the green Earth-like planet with a much smaller dark blue-gray round grain of newly formed world matter, a charcoal center and one rough ridge on its surface, surrounded by a very fine rose-pink dust ring. No green continents, oceans, white clouds or recognizable Earth geography. Keep it suspended within the existing thread loop beneath the dark star-filled hands; the thread loop and hands retain their shape and positions. This is the story's first small cool rough world, not a finished Earth.
Preserve every other pixel as closely as possible: all three fully draped Front/Side/Back character views, dark empty hood and star-filled hands and bare feet, rose mantle with cyan lining and perforations, Guarding and Wonder studies, modest opaque clothing, gray paper background, layout, and the exact readable labels "Orya", "The Unspent Star", "Front", "Side", "Back", "Guarding", "Wonder", "Making". Maintain painterly oil texture. No new objects or text.
character_sheet.selection: Consistent fully draped Front, Side and Back views; Guarding and Wonder adapt expressions to faceless hood/hand gestures; Making shows dark rough world matter rather than an unsupported Earth-like planet. Name, story and panel labels inspected.
character_sheet.normalization: Encoded WebP from accepted generated correction; no creative editing with Python.

location.original_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: location reference painting, landscape 1536 x 1024, no text.
Input images: image 1 gives Orya's INSIDE universe, planetary rings, and rose/cyan cosmic palette; image 2 gives the glass enclosure only, no outside portrait for this painting; image 3 brushwork/style only, do not import orchard scene.
Primary request: Paint Orya's ring universe from INSIDE, before her final opaque shell. A dark rounded world lies below a broad rose-pink planetary ring that makes a curving path through foreground and across middle distance. Several smaller dark worlds have delicate rings, one little rough world newly made nearby. Alien stars under a very dark sky include a small wandering rose light with a pale trailing edge. An adult dark star-filled feminine figure in a rose hood and flowing perforated rose mantle with cyan lining hovers just above the broad ring in the middle distance, clearly recognizably the figure from image 1; the place is the main subject, but do not replace her with an ordinary human. Her universe feels inhabited and vast, with no architecture, cliffs, coast, spacecraft or other people. If the glass curvature is hinted, keep it extremely distant/subtle; she begins unaware of a wall.
Style/medium: Group of Seven inspired oil painting like reference 3, broad rhythmic opaque shapes of value and color, varied directional strokes, selective impasto and quiet dark connecting passages, restrained motivated rose/cyan starlight. Strong layered depth and a readable ring path, no glossy CGI, no ubiquitous rim lighting, no enormous lens flares, no orchard greens/brown palette, no text.
location.correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: selected correction of the ring-universe location painting, landscape 1536 x 1024.
Input image 1 is the edit target (the existing oil painting). Preserve its composition, worlds, rings, painterly style, black sky, palette, and the cosmic woman in her rose/cyan perforated mantle. Do not change her identity or add any people.
Change ONLY the rose companion light: remove the large red comet/streak in the upper-right sky, restoring quiet dark star field there. Put instead a SMALL soft rose star with a very short pale trailing edge drifting just to the right of Orya's shoulder, clearly separate from her cloak and not touching her hood. It should feel like the same surprising, unspent light she keeps beside her in the story, rather than a huge streaking meteor far away. Restrained pink luminosity from that one little light, matching the painting's opaque brushwork. Preserve all other stars, cosmic form, clothes, rings, and dark connecting passages. No text.
location.selection: The correction replaces a large distant comet with a small rose companion light near Orya's shoulder; rings, dark worlds, identity and painterly composition preserved. Original painting retained separately.

discarded: First interpretation's generated art preserved in Git and outside package. One new sheet generation was blocked by the image safety filter; final sheet uses genuinely fully draped mantle studies. Uncorrected Earth-like sheet remains outside package.
canon: Visual interpretation only; no universe facts or canon promotion.
